content.comment_body: Hello, I have a new PC without a DVD drive, but only have a DVD containing [product_name] [version_no]. Is it possible to download this software for free online? (I can't find a product key on the DVD...) Thanks for your help.

[product_name] does not require a product key or license key. Use a computer with a DVD drive to copy the DVD contents onto a USB stick, then install from there. Downloading the DVD legally is not possible from [company_name] official websites.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter trouble installing [product_name] [version_no] on newer computers without DVD drives. Since there is no official online download or licensing system, installation requires copying the DVD via a USB stick. This highlights a lack of accessible digital distribution, causing inconvenience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to freely download [product_name] [version_no] from the internet or [company_name]'s official website rather than relying on physical media.
